description: Resumable file uploads and media processing with Uppy and Transloadit. Embed a Dashboard or upload button, use server-signed Templates or Assembly Instructions, and connect results to Bubble workflows.
instructions: Add Transloadit Uploader to a page. Supply params JSON and its matching server-generated SHA-384 signature. Choose inline Dashboard or an upload button. Read Result URLs and Results JSON after Encoding completed. Never put an Auth Secret in client-side properties. See the repository README for setup.
